It can be obtained by taking this item from a [[Bladecaster]] [[Mercenary]] with this item offered as a reward after winning a duel. |is_drop_restricted = true |release_version = 3.26.0 }} '''Bladefall of Trarthus''' is a [[Physical damage|physical]] [[spell]] that once activated continuously spends [[mana]] to fire ethereal blades raining down from the sky at nearby enemies. The blade volleys leave behind [[Lingering Blades]] that interact with other skills. It is a [[Trarthan gem|Trarthan]] version of {{il|Bladefall}}. __TOC__ ==Changes from default version== Unlike the original skill, this Trarthan version is an [[instant]] skill that [[cost]]s a continuous percentage of your maximum [[mana]] while active, during which it will automatically fire a volley of blades at a nearby enemy at a rate based on your maximum mana. It has lower damage and damage effectiveness per hit, and enemies cannot be hit multiple times from the same volley. The skill cannot be [[trigger]]ed or supported by [[Proxy|proxies]]. Only one instance of Bladefall of Trarthus can be active at a time. ==Skill functions and interactions== *'''Area of effect:''' Increases and reductions to [[area of effect]] apply to the area of each volley and the impact area of each blade. A single enemy can only hit by a single blade's area of effect per volley even if multiple blades' areas overlap. This causes damage to be capped per volley regardless of the number of overlaps, and due to its specific targeting of enemies, there is no benefit to increase the number of overlaps in a single-target scenario. *'''Lingering Blades''': Each volley of Bladefall of Trarthus leaves behind a [[Lingering Blade]] on the ground. These blades can be detonated with {{il|Blade Blast}} or animated with {{il|Animate Weapon}}. Lingering Blades have a duration of 6 seconds. *'''Charges generation''': Bladefall of Trarthus bypasses the limitation of 1 [[charge]] per skill use with charge on hit effect. Multiple charges can be generated from each volley. *'''With {{il|Lifetap Support}}''': Will cost [[life]] but still based on your maximum [[mana]]. *'''With [[Blood Magic]]''': Will not cost any [[life]] (or [[mana]]) to sustain. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Physical
